greyfang.title: The Greyfang Pack
greyfang.giver: Maren, keeper of the north road waystation
greyfang.description: Wolves of the Greyfang pack have been taking carts on the north road. Maren asked me to deal with them.

objectives.text: Kill the Greyfang wolves north-east of the waystation.

outcomes.text: The north road is safe again. Maren paid me in gold and a healing potion, and told the Riverwatch garrison who to thank.

waking_stones.title: The Waking Stones
waking_stones.giver: Brannoc, a scout of the Riverwatch garrison
waking_stones.description: The old stone circle west of the waystation has been glowing since the new moon. Brannoc wants to know why, but won't go near it himself.

objectives.text: Investigate the glowing crystal in the stone circle.
Find three rune shards scattered around the stone circle.
Bring the rune shards to Brannoc.
Return the rune shards to the crystal.

outcomes.text: I gave the shards to Brannoc for the scholars of Riverwatch. The garrison paid well, and the captain knows my name.
I returned the shards to the stones. The crystal burns brighter now, and some of its light stayed with me.
I kept the shards for myself. Brannoc won't forget it, and neither will the garrison.
